desc: Derive and verify the sliding-window median cost formula using Fenwick trees for counts and sums, including negative values and duplicate elements.
Design Fenwick-tree operations for insertion, deletion, median lookup, and distance-cost calculation.
Formulate and verify the non-overlapping interval DP for selecting exactly \(k\) windows.
Implement the complete efficient solution with coordinate compression and integer-safe costs.
Verify edge cases including adjacent windows, negative values, duplicate values, \(x=2\), \(k=1\), and all-equal arrays.
